newsitem.title: CANADA: Morrison to set public offering of units.
newsitem.headline: Morrison to set public offering of units.

text.p: Morrison Petroleums Ltd said on Monday it filed a preliminary prospectus with Canadian regulators for an initial public offering of trust units based on its interest in an Alberta natural gas plant and related facilities.
Morrison said the trust unit offering was being made by a syndicate of underwriters led by ScotiaMcleod Inc.
The issue price was expected to be determined when the final prospectus is filed in January, it said.

After the sale of the new Morrison Facilities Income fund units closes, a subsidiary of the fund would acquire Morrison Petroleums' interest in its recently purchased Nevis Gas Plant and related facilities as well as the Canadian producer's 100-percent interest in a crude oil pipeline in northeast British Columbia.
Morrison said it intended to use proceeds from the issue to reduce long-term debt, allowing to to accelerate development of explloration prospects or pursue other opportunities.

Other underwriters of the deal, which will not be offered in the United States, include Nesbitt Burns Inc, RBC Dominion Securities Inc, CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Inc, Midland Walwyn Capital Inc, TD Securities Inc, FirstEnergy Capital Corp and Gordon Capital Corp.
